about: Evaluator changes made after the pre-registration R2 (e1024a2). None touches the questions, gold, scoring, or criteria.

items.made_after: both runs (baseline 6d238db's run record, cross-check ae82356), before any human review or official verdict
items.what: check_runs accepted only runs from one commit, but contract section 9.1 commits each run before the next, so the two 3-5 runs name e1024a2 and 6d238db. For 3-5 the judge now accepts different run commits when everything between them is under eval/template_3-5/runs/, and compares each run's own commit (not only the cross-check one) with the freeze record.
items.why: a contradiction between the contract's run procedure and the judge, found by the first exploratory judge call; the Codex pre-registration review did not catch it
items.alternatives_considered: re-running the cross-check from one commit (refused: the contract allows re-runs only for infrastructure failures, and the model is not deterministic); reporting the verdict as suspended
items.effect_on_scores: none: outcomes, criteria, and scores are computed exactly as before
